dedupe_keys.name: united states water withdrawals database uswwd user level withdrawals in 42 states

description: The United States Water Withdrawals Database (USWWD) is a standardized compilation of user-level water withdrawal data from state agencies, described in a Scientific Data descriptor. It holds 188,857 water users, 353,694 points of diversion and use, and 58,439,412 withdrawal volumes in 7,524,266 records, with water users, locations, volumes, source types and primary use categories across sectors. Coverage is 42 US states; some other states collect such data but restrict public access. The data are a free download from HydroShare under CC BY, as two CSV files per state with metadata tables and the standardization code. Caveats: volumes mix direct measurements with the estimation methods of each state agency, and location points may be points of diversion or of use depending on the state. Simulation uses: sector water demand and abstraction patterns for public supply and irrigation capacity planning and drought studies. Related records: the USGS public supply water use reanalysis (data-usgs-public-supply-water-use-reanalysis-huc12) and CaRDS (data-cards-california-residential-water-demand-supply).
